dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: #Oh, when did you arrive, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I was completely lost in thought.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Aw, you're concerned for my well-being. Well, aren't you just the sweetest?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: You really know how to make me feel all warm and fuzzy inside.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Don't you worry, I love it here.

choices.text: Is there any part you would want to renovate?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Not at all.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I think what makes this place so special is the fact that it was built personally by you.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: If I were to start nitpicking, it would only ruin your creativity and the unique charm you bring to the place.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I certainly wouldn't want that to happen.

choices.text: Do you have any suggestions on how to improve the place?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: When would I ever not?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: If it weren't for my library work and potion-making duties, I'd love nothing more than to spend every day chatting with you like this.

choices.text: Have there been many people borrowing books recently?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: The number of people borrowing books is around the same as always. But lately, more people seem to be returning them on time than ever before.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: It seems that the citizens of the "City of Freedom" have become more conscious of time. Frankly, I'm quite relieved.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Of course, I can't expect everyone to be as sensible as you, cutie.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Haha...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: #You look so adorable with a little more red in your cheeks, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Special potions? Hmm...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Oh! As a matter of fact, I concocted one that makes textiles softer to the touch.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: And another that keeps the air fragrant and fresh. I'm quite fond of that one.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: They weren't requested by the Knights of Favonius, though. I just made them out of personal interest.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hmm... Is it just me, or have my interests become more domestic in nature since I met you...?

choices.text: Lisa, you're making me blush again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I'd quite like to invite you to afternoon tea.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I can offer you Sunsettia or Rose Bud Tea... And as for snacks, what kind of cake do you like?

choices.text: Are you going to bake it yourself?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Haha, you guessed correctly.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: There is nothing I can't create if I put my mind to it.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: It's just that...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Most of the time, I don't find these sort of things to be worth all the extra effort.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: But you are special to me. I don't think about energy spent if it's for you.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hmm, perhaps instead of asking for your preferences...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: ...I should let it be a surprise instead.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Your kind offer alone was the most delightful surprise I could hope for.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Oh my! Remind me not to add too much sugar, because you, cutie, are sweet enough already.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Seriously, though, I need to start getting prepared...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: We can't have you underestimating me.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Ah, you're so easygoing. It's so relaxing spending time with you.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: But for once, I do want to take the trouble to make something nice.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Lisa.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Morning, cutie.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I'm sure you're keeping on top of everything that needs doing.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: But if you find yourself struggling at any point, you know I'm always available to lend a hand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Lisa.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Have a good night, cutie.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: *yawn* I'm so sleepy. I'm a little envious of the way you manage to stay so energetic even at this hour.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Be sure to get enough sleep...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: You have good taste in literature.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Large bookshelves and a fireplace... This would be a most comfy place to put my feet up.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I must reward you well for making this place so cozy.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Oh? A place suited for quiet research, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Not only are reference materials readily available, but you can initiate experiments at any time as well. This is truly a mage's ideal workshop.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: You really are a cutie after my own heart.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: This is... a 【simple】 dialog that was triggered 【without the editor】!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It all makes sense now!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: ...I feel like you're just pretending to understand.
